# forumulate_status_groups (Resource)

The component groups of a status page, in page order: what each says about itself, which sits inside which, which starts folded, its row layout and whether its rows print uptime.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_status_groups" "page" {
  space_id = var.status_space_id
  group {
    name        = "Core"
    description = "What every customer touches."
  }
  group {
    name        = "Integrations"
    layout      = "grid-2"
    hide_uptime = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `space_id` (String) The status page (space) id.

### Optional

- `group` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--group))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `collapsed` (Boolean) Starts folded.
- `description` (String)
- `hide_uptime` (Boolean) Its rows print no uptime figure.
- `layout` (String) `list`, `grid-2` or `cards`; unset follows the page.
- `parent` (String) The group it sits inside (one level).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_status_groups.page STATUS_SPACE_ID
```
